items.why_watch: A short, visually driven introduction to ocean creatures aimed at toddlers and preschoolers, covering marine life through colorful scenes and playful repetition. discovery_articles.title: Fir Street Cemetery in Cleveland, Ohio
discovery_articles.snippet: In the mid-nineteenth century, farmland west of Cleveland was purchased by real estate speculators and subdivided for development. The Fir Street Cemetery, as it is currently known, occupies just eight residential lots in what first became Brooklyn Township and is now incorporated within Cleveland. In spite of its small size, the burial ground is historically three separate graveyards.
discovery_articles.ferns_note: Three separate graveyards compressed into eight residential lots — the dead here have been quietly neighboring each other across denominations and decades, ignored by the city that grew up around them. There's something unsettling about the fact that Cleveland essentially forgot it was built on top of multiple burial grounds.

discovery_articles.title: A Landlord Found a Peculiar Print Hanging in a Vacant Apartment. It Turned Out to Be an Original Picasso That Had Been Missing for Eight Years
discovery_articles.snippet: When "Torero" vanished from a Milwaukee art gallery in 2018, the owners didn't know whether they'd ever see it again. The man who found the etching turned it over to the police earlier this month
discovery_articles.ferns_note: A Picasso spent eight years hanging in a vacant apartment — not in a vault, not a collector's private study, but an empty room where no one was even looking. The most quietly surreal part: a landlord doing routine checks stumbled onto a missing masterpiece the way you'd stumble onto a forgotten umbrella.

puzzle.label: Fern's Morning Riddle
puzzle.prompt: I have a heart that never beats, I have a home but I never sleep. I can take a man's house and build another, And I love to play games with my many brothers. I am a king among fools. Who am I ?
puzzle.answer: The King of Hearts in a deck of cards
